short_description: Enterprise measurement-based care platform with 300+ assessments, 85+ EHR integrations, and automated outcome tracking for behavioral health organizations.
long_description: Greenspace Health is a best-in-class measurement-based care platform that automates the collection and visualization of patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) throughout treatment. The platform offers over 300 evidence-based assessments delivered automatically via SMS, email, or kiosk, with instant visualization for clinicians. Greenspace integrates with 85+ EHR/EMR systems including Epic, Oracle Cerner, Athenahealth, and Netsmart using FHIR, HL7, and open APIs. Evidence shows that regularly measuring progress with Greenspace increases the likelihood of significant patient improvement by 3.5x, improves clinical outcomes by 42%, and reduces no-show rates by 40%. The platform achieves an 83% assessment completion rate and is trusted by behavioral health clinics, hospitals, integrated health systems, and university student health centers.

faqs.q: How many assessments does Greenspace Health offer?
faqs.a: Greenspace Health offers over 300 evidence-based assessments including PHQ-9, GAD-7, PCL-5, AUDIT, and many more. The Basic plan includes 18 assessments, with full library access on higher tiers.

faqs.q: What EHR systems does Greenspace integrate with?
faqs.a: Greenspace integrates with 85+ EHR/EMR systems including Epic, Oracle Cerner, Meditech, Netsmart, Athenahealth, AdvancedMD, and NextGen using FHIR, HL7, and open APIs.

faqs.q: What is the assessment completion rate with Greenspace?
faqs.a: Greenspace achieves an 83% average assessment completion rate across implementations, significantly higher than paper-based or manual assessment approaches.

faqs.q: Is Greenspace HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Greenspace Health is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and also compliant with PIPEDA and PHIPA for Canadian customers.
